units.source_text: 答：他目前创立了幽灵厌世主义，正在讨论能否自我“复活”。

en.t: Answer: At present, he has founded ghostly pessimism and is discussing whether he can bring himself back to life.

units.source_text: 但是自从他知道了霍乱也是细菌引起的疾病之后，似乎安心了很多。

en.t: But ever since he learned that cholera, too, is a disease caused by bacteria, he seems to have felt much more at ease.
